title: Particle Identifiers
description: Validates particle effect identifiers for proper namespace formatting. Particle identifiers should follow the creator:name convention.

101.title: File Read Error
101.description: Error when the particle JSON file could not be read. Check file permissions and format.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the path to the unreadable file

102.title: Version Read Error
102.description: Error when the format_version field could not be read from the particle definition.
102.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains details about the version parsing failure

103.title: Invalid Identifier
103.description: Error when a particle identifier doesn't follow the expected namespace:name format. Use your creator namespace prefix (e.g., mypack:custom_particle).
103.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the invalid particle identifier
